name: wildcard-import
desc: a wildcard import brings the visible items of a module in scope
code: import package::m1::*; const y = x + z;

modules.package::m1: const x: u32 = 3; const z: u32 = 4; const unused: u32 = 5;

result: const package_m1_x: u32 = 3; const package_m1_z: u32 = 4; const y = package_m1_x + package_m1_z;

name: wildcard-import-relative
desc: a wildcard import can use a relative path
result: const package_m2_w: u32 = 3; const package_m1_x = package_m2_w; const y = package_m1_x;

name: wildcard-import-private-decl
desc: a wildcard import omits private declarations

name: wildcard-import-package-decl-cross-package
desc: a wildcard import from another package omits non-public declarations

name: wildcard-import-submodule-contents
desc: a wildcard import does not bring in the contents of submodules

name: wildcard-import-submodule-names
desc: a wildcard import does not bring in submodule names

name: wildcard-import-collection
desc: a wildcard can be a member of an import collection
code: import package::{m1::x, m2::*}; const y = x + z;
result: const package_m1_x: u32 = 3; const package_m2_z: u32 = 4; const y = package_m1_x + package_m2_z;

name: wildcard-import-collection-sibling-branch
desc: a sibling branch of a collection does not widen the wildcard

modules.package::m1::m2: const w: u32 = 2; const x: u32 = 3;

name: wildcard-import-reexport
desc: a wildcard import brings in public re-exports
result: const package_m2_x: u32 = 3; const y = package_m2_x;

name: wildcard-import-bare-import-not-exported
desc: a wildcard import does not bring in the bare imports of a module

name: wildcard-import-wildcard-not-exported
desc: a wildcard import does not bring in the wildcard imports of a module

name: wildcard-import-shadowed-by-declaration
desc: a local declaration takes precedence over a wildcard import
code: import package::m1::*; const x: f32 = 1.0; const y = x;
result: const x: f32 = 1.0; const y = x;

name: wildcard-import-shadowed-by-named-import
desc: a named import takes precedence over a wildcard import
code: import package::m1::x; import package::m2::*; const y = x;
result: const package_m1_x: u32 = 3; const y = package_m1_x;

name: wildcard-import-shadowed-by-local
desc: a function-local declaration takes precedence over a wildcard import
code: import package::m1::*; fn f() -> u32 { let x = 1u; return x; }
result: fn f() -> u32 { let x = 1u; return x; }

name: wildcard-import-shadows-builtin
desc: a wildcard imported name takes precedence over a WGSL built-in

modules.package::m1: fn clamp(x: f32) -> f32 { return x; }

result: fn package_m1_clamp(x: f32) -> f32 { return x; } const y = package_m1_clamp(1.0);

name: wildcard-import-builtin-fallback
desc: a built-in is used when no wildcard imports the name
code: import package::m1::*; const y = clamp(1.0, 0.0, 1.0) + x;
result: const package_m1_x: f32 = 1.0; const y = clamp(1.0, 0.0, 1.0) + package_m1_x;

name: wildcard-import-ambiguous
desc: two wildcards providing different declarations of a referenced name is an error
code: import package::m1::*; import package::m2::*; const y = x;

name: wildcard-import-ambiguous-unreferenced
desc: a name provided by two wildcards is only an error where it is referenced
code: import package::m1::*; import package::m2::*; const y = z;

modules.package::m1: const x: u32 = 3; const z: u32 = 1;

result: const package_m1_z: u32 = 1; const y = package_m1_z;

name: wildcard-import-ambiguous-same-declaration
desc: two wildcards providing the same declaration is not ambiguous
code: import package::m1::*; import package::m2::*; const y = x;
result: const package_m3_x: u32 = 3; const y = package_m3_x;

name: wildcard-import-ambiguous-named-import
desc: a named import resolves an ambiguity between wildcards
code: import package::m1::*; import package::m2::{x, *}; const y = x;
result: const package_m2_x: u32 = 4; const y = package_m2_x;

name: wildcard-import-ambiguous-inline-path
desc: an inline path resolves an ambiguity between wildcards
code: import package::m1::*; import package::m2::*; const y = package::m2::x;
result: const package_m2_x: u32 = 4; const y = package_m2_x;

name: wildcard-import-external-wildcardable
desc: a wildcard import from an external module marked wildcardable
result: const foo_m1_x: u32 = 3; const y = foo_m1_x;

name: wildcard-import-external-unsupported
desc: a wildcard import from an external module not marked wildcardable is an error

name: wildcard-import-external-unsupported-suppressed
desc: unsupported_wildcard can be suppressed on the import
code: @diagnostic(off, unsupported_wildcard) import foo::m1::*; const y = x;
result: const foo_m1_x: u32 = 3; const y = foo_m1_x;

name: wildcard-import-external-unsupported-suppressed-module
desc: unsupported_wildcard can be suppressed for the module
code: import foo::m1::*; diagnostic(off, unsupported_wildcard); const y = x;
result: const foo_m1_x: u32 = 3; const y = foo_m1_x;

name: wildcard-import-cross-package-in-library
desc: a cross-package wildcard import in library code is an error

modules.foo::m1: import bar::m2::*; public fn f() -> u32 { return x; }

name: wildcard-import-cross-package-in-library-suppressed
desc: cross_package_wildcard can be suppressed on the import

modules.foo::m1: @diagnostic(off, cross_package_wildcard) import bar::m2::*; public fn f() -> u32 { return x; }

result: const import_2_foo_bar_m2_x: u32 = 3; fn foo_m1_f() -> u32 { return import_2_foo_bar_m2_x; } const y = foo_m1_f();

name: wildcard-import-missing-module
desc: a wildcard import of a module that does not exist is an error

name: wildcard-import-conditional
desc: a wildcard import removed by conditional translation is not resolved

name: wildcard-syntax-path
desc: a wildcard follows a module path
code: import package::m1::*; import super::m2::m3::*; import foo::*;

name: wildcard-syntax-collection
desc: a wildcard can be a member of a collection
code: import foo::{a::b, *}; import {foo::*}; import foo::{a::*, c as d};

name: wildcard-syntax-bare
desc: a bare wildcard is an error

name: wildcard-syntax-bare-collection
desc: a bare wildcard in a collection is an error

name: wildcard-syntax-rename
desc: a wildcard cannot be renamed

name: wildcard-syntax-public
desc: public import with a wildcard is reserved

name: wildcard-syntax-public-collection
desc: public import with a wildcard in a collection is reserved

name: module-attribute-syntax
desc: module attributes follow imports and precede declarations

name: module-attribute-after-declaration
desc: module attributes cannot follow declarations

name: module-attribute-unterminated
desc: module attributes end with a semicolon
